name: Federal Energy Efficient Commercial Buildings Deduction (IRC Section 179D)
summary: Federal tax deduction for qualifying energy-efficient commercial building improvements.
verify: Deduction amount is indexed annually and has separate rules for prevailing wage/apprenticeship. Confirm current $/sqft and eligibility at irs.gov before quoting a client.

name: USDA Rural Energy for America Program (REAP)
summary: Grants and guaranteed loans for energy efficiency and renewable energy for agricultural producers and rural small businesses.
verify: Funding cycles and grant percentages change; confirm current terms at rd.usda.gov.

name: DSIRE state and utility incentive database
summary: Not a program itself — the standard reference for looking up current state, utility, and local incentives by ZIP code.
verify: Use dsireusa.org to find the specific programs live in the building's state/utility territory, then add them here as their own entries.
